newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne says HK offer extended to Jun 23.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne says HK offer extended to Jun 23.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc on Wednesday said HK Acquisitions Corp extended until June 23 the expiration of its offer to buy all outstanding shares of Envirodyne for $8.50 each.
HK Acquisitions, formed by Envirodyne director Michael Heisley and former Envirodyne chairman Donald Kelly, made its offer on June 12. It was due to expire Wednesday.
Envirodyne said the extension was made at the request of a committee of independent Envirodyne directors.
Shares of Envirodyne, a food packaging and service supplier, closed Wednesday unchanged at 8-3/8.
